meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 跑 claude-mem 观察者任务时,它只回两种结果:无可记内容就回 <skip_summary reason="noise" />,完成一个可搜索单元就回一条 <observation> XML(真实标题、4–10 条带路径事实和叙述)。
howto.when: 当你在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem 的 observer 任务时接管:空闲、初始化或无工具结果时回 skip_summary,完成可搜索单元时回 observation。

say.text: 这次没有可记录的内容,只回 skip_summary。
把这个搜索单元写成一条 observation XML,标题用真实标题。
say.note: 输出含标题、事实与路径的 observation。

say.text: 不要用散文回答,直接给我观察 XML。
say.note: 散文会被丢弃,只保留 XML。

howto.what_en: On claude-mem observer jobs in Grok Bot it replies with two forms only: <skip_summary reason="noise" /> when nothing is worth recording, or one <observation> XML (real title, 4–10 facts with paths, narrative) when a searchable unit is done.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you run claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: skip_summary on idle, init, or no tool results; observation when a searchable unit is done.

say_en.text: Nothing to record this time - reply with skip_summary only.
Turn this search unit into one observation XML with a real title.
say_en.note: It outputs an observation with facts and paths.

say_en.text: No prose, give me the observation XML directly.
say_en.note: Prose is dropped; only the XML is kept.
